author: Taylor Matney
text: Highly recommend! Nathan Hicks was incredible to work with. He arrived on time, got the job done, and above all was so nice. He is very friendly and helpful. We will definitely use Morgantown Septic Tank Service in the future!

author: John Squires
text: I needed a septic tank pumped and gave Morgantown Septic a call.  I liked everything they told me and scheduled an early morning time for the service. The truck showed up on time and the driver was very courteous and professional.  The price was exactly as quoted. I would highly recommend Morgantown Septic for those needing septic pumping.

author: John McCoy
text: Had our septic aeration tank pumped. Service was timely and professional. Staff very helpful, and friendly. Would highly recommend their services!
